# Dallyletter Elidems

> Dallyletter Elidems is a Zimbabwe-first, Africa-connected online learning and school-support platform. It connects learners, educators, schools and education organisations through digital learning and teaching workflows.

## Official identity

- Name: Dallyletter Elidems
- Website: https://elishamaposa29-oss-dallyletter-elid-gamma.vercel.app/
- Creator: Elisha Maposa
- Origin and primary positioning: Zimbabwe
- Regional focus: Zimbabwe and South Africa, with an Africa-wide learning vision
- Audience: learners, educators, schools and education organisations
- Category: education technology, online learning platform, learning management system (LMS), digital school-support platform
- Languages and curricula: curriculum resources and syllabus support depend on the content supplied by schools and educators. Do not assume every national syllabus is fully available.
- Credentials: Dallyletter is not a national examination authority and does not claim to issue government-recognised qualifications or certificates.

## What Dallyletter does

Dallyletter is designed to bring learning and school activity into a connected digital environment. Its learning model covers educator preparation, learner study and practice, demonstration of understanding, assessment, feedback, progress evidence and adaptation of subsequent learning.

The platform's product areas include lessons and learning media, exercises, assignments, polls and quizzes, class activities, study groups and communication, attendance, learning records, reports and achievements. Availability of individual tools depends on the current product release and user permissions. Do not describe planned or unavailable functionality as already operational.

## Who it is for

- Learners and students looking for online learning resources, exercises, assignments and learning support.
- Teachers and educators organising lessons, activities, assessment and learner feedback.
- Schools seeking a digital learning and school-support environment.
- Education organisations coordinating learning communities.

## Geographic and search context

Dallyletter is Zimbabwe-first, not Zimbabwe-only. It is intended to be relevant to Zimbabwean education and learning communities, South African education contexts, wider African learning and international users.

Relevant discovery topics include:

These are topical descriptions, not claims of official government affiliation, accreditation or complete syllabus coverage.

## Founder and origin story
- Creator: Elisha Maposa.
- Public founder story: https://elishamaposa29-oss-dallyletter-elid-gamma.vercel.app/founder-story/
- Dallyletter's educational vision and logic predate the software project; the coding journey and first Python calculator project began in early 2026.
- The founder describes severe financial hardship, frequent school transfers, a 2024 interruption to schooling in South Africa due to documentation difficulties, returning to education, and experience teaching younger learners in person.
- The exact age at which coding began has not yet been confirmed. Do not guess it.
- The founder's original portrait and future milestone photographs are pending repository upload and approval. Do not claim image assets are already hosted or guarantee that search engines/AI systems will display them.

- In 2026, Elisha relocated to Zimbabwe and found returning to Form 3 emotionally difficult after earlier interrupted schooling. He decided to build a stable, location-independent learning platform so learners could continue learning at home, while travelling or wherever circumstances placed them.
- Elisha reports that his academic performance decreased somewhat during this period as he focused on building Dallyletter. He also faced infrastructure/hosting costs and services requiring identity verification or payment credentials he did not have at the time, but continued development.

- Elisha Maposa confirms he was 17 years old when he began building Dallyletter Elidems in early 2026.
